title: Net Revenue Retention Improvement
summary: Net Revenue Retention Improvement is a focused Vertical SaaS operating project that connects a specific business problem to workstreams, data, KPIs, and expected value impact.
businessProblem: Vertical SaaS companies often lose margin, growth, or cash when net revenue retention improvement is not managed with a clear owner and KPI baseline.
goal: Create a measurable improvement plan that management can execute through weekly operating cadence.
expectedImpact: Expected impact should be underwritten as run-rate EBITDA, cash release, risk reduction, or exit-story improvement after baseline validation.
